limitations.subject: False-positive generalization
limitations.boundary: The observed false-positive rate is exactly 0/44 for the labelled negative fixture cases. This bounded sample is not a population-wide statistical guarantee for every language, corpus, or artifact type.

limitations.subject: Pseudo-path suppression
limitations.boundary: URI fragments, regex anchors, versioned routes, templated routes, common JSON Pointer roots, and unknown single-component slash tokens are intentionally suppressed. A real filesystem path with one of those lexical shapes will be missed.

limitations.subject: UNC and network-share paths
limitations.boundary: Double-slash and backslash UNC roots are not classified because they overlap protocol-relative URLs and network identifiers. Drive-letter Windows absolute paths are supported.

limitations.subject: Dynamically constructed paths
limitations.boundary: Lexically split, concatenated, encoded, encrypted, compressed, generated-at-runtime, or environment-expanded paths are not reconstructed.

limitations.subject: Artifact encoding and node types
limitations.boundary: The declared portable scan closure is UTF-8 regular files only. Binary, invalid UTF-8, symlink, special, missing, and duplicate nodes fail closed unless explicitly excluded; binary content is not inspected.

limitations.subject: Quoted-string parsing
limitations.boundary: The scanner supports ordinary single- and double-quoted values and escaped characters, but it is not a full parser for every programming language's raw strings, heredocs, interpolation, or multiline literal rules.

limitations.subject: Checkout declaration
limitations.boundary: Checkout-specific classification requires the caller to provide each absolute checkout root. Undeclared checkout roots may still be reported as absolute paths but cannot receive checkout-specific classification.

limitations.subject: Observed reasoning configuration
limitations.boundary: The runtime identifies the model family as GPT-5.6 Sol, while no separately attestable xhigh reasoning control is exposed to the producer. The immutable input requested gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh and xhigh.

limitations.subject: Independent acceptance
limitations.boundary: Focused, seeded, adversarial, taxonomy, ownership, and immutable-readback checks are producer execution evidence. Coordinator ingestion, COMPLETED state, and independent acceptance remain outside this return.

limitations.subject: Cross-platform runtime matrix
limitations.boundary: Execution occurred on Linux with Python 3.12.3 and Git 2.43.0. Native Windows and macOS process/runtime behavior was not executed, although Windows drive-letter strings are lexical fixtures.
